sonnet.problem: The true/false card asks about Zechariah 12:8 before any story card has told that verse. The story card that tells it (card 16) comes afterward. The baker has to answer with no setup, and the order doesn't follow the passage.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.

sonnet.problem: The card says the prophecy 'turns to the house of David'. Verse 7 is about the tents of Judah being saved first. The house of David only appears in the reason clause. The card stretches the text and also leads toward the answer to card 14.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.
